entries.name: Velocity Swipe
entries.description: Fast whip-pan to the next clip with directional motion blur that peaks mid-swipe.

entries.name: Liquid Melt
entries.description: The outgoing clip melts downward in wavy drips, revealing the next clip underneath.

entries.name: RGB Displacement
entries.description: Splits the red and blue channels apart along an angle — static, pulsing to a rhythm, or glitching in bursts.

entries.name: Hero Entrance
entries.description: Impact entrance for the whole clip: a fast zoom-slam with an exposure flash and a decaying RGB split.

entries.name: Beat Impact
entries.description: Punches the picture on every detected percussive hit: a zoom pulse and exposure flash that decay between beats.

entries.name: Golden Film
entries.description: Warm analog stock — golden highlights, sunlit mids, soft blacks, film halation and fine grain.

entries.name: Dreamy
entries.description: Soft-focus editorial glow — peach-lavender split tone, blooming highlights, rich pastel color.

entries.name: Teal & Orange
entries.description: Blockbuster grade — teal-pushed shadows and foliage, warm orange skin and highlights, punchy S-curve.

entries.name: Disposable Camera
entries.description: 90s flash snapshot — hot warm highlights, greenish shadows, coarse grain, plastic-lens softness.

entries.name: Cyber Neon
entries.description: Neon nightlife — cyan, magenta and violet pulled from every hue, glowing highlights, electric edges.

entries.name: Dark Mood
entries.description: Cinematic noir — rich blacks, sunken mids, muted color, a warm ember left in skin tones.

entries.name: Luxury
entries.description: Editorial polish — creamy shadows, luminous skin, sophisticated neutral palette, refined contrast.

entries.name: Soft Glow
entries.description: Optical diffusion — blooming luminous highlights, gentle light scatter, faithful color and detail.

entries.name: Bleach Bypass
entries.description: Silver-retention cinema — hard contrast, steel-cool tonality, metallic highlights, gritty texture.

entries.name: Monochrome
entries.description: Fine-art B&W — channel-mixed luminance, rich separation, deep detailed blacks, silver-print finish.

entries.name: Cinematic Lens Flare
entries.description: Anamorphic light streak with a hot core and ghost reflections that drifts slowly — cinema-grade flare, not a grade.

entries.name: Light Leak
entries.description: Analog film burn — warm light spilling in from the frame edge with organic drift and exposure flicker.

entries.name: God Rays
entries.description: Volumetric light shafts from a source point — adjustable fan, slow sway, gentle breathing.

entries.name: Prism Refraction
entries.description: Spectral dispersion — RGB planes split radially around a point while a rainbow glint sweeps the frame.

entries.name: Floating Dust
entries.description: Atmospheric particles drifting in light — depth-varied sizes, lazy organic motion and gentle glints.

entries.name: Star Glint
entries.description: Lens sparkle on highlights — multi-point optical glints that bloom and fade on bright details.

entries.name: Neon Trails
entries.description: Long-exposure light streaks on organic paths — glowing heads with decaying tails, city-night energy.

entries.name: Golden Rays
entries.description: Golden-hour volumetric light — warm shafts with a soft ambient halo and slow atmospheric drift.

entries.name: Floating Embers
entries.description: Warm embers drifting upward — glowing sparks with organic rise, flicker and natural lifecycles.

entries.name: Cinematic Fog
entries.description: Layered volumetric mist — drifting density banks with parallax depth and soft low pooling.

entries.name: Fireflies
entries.description: Drifting fireflies — wandering luminous insects with organic paths and gentle blinking.

entries.name: Falling Snow
entries.description: Depth-layered snowfall — near and far flakes drifting down at different speeds with lateral sway.
